text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of that showdown was being 
watched by a certain Umamusume as well—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Here she comes, as expected! Overtaking 
Sakura Chiyono O, she surges forward to 
claim the shield of the Autumn Tenno Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I won't lose... I won't lose...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...The outcome of the race is practically 
decided already, isn't it? And yet, 
you..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So you continue to keep that fire burning 
in your eyes, do you...?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The lead doesn't change! She goes all the 
way across the fi—nish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible skill! Magnificent talent! They 
have brilliantly seized the glory of the 
Shield!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Chiyo-chan...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if you didn't win, that was more than 
enough... I saw how hard you fought out 
there...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah... *pant*, ah... *wheeze*... 
*gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(If this is a wall... it's far too thick. 
There isn't even a crevice for me to grasp 
right now.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(What we were born with is just far too 
different... Having such talent flaunted 
before me...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...What good is talent? What does it... 
even matter?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary, ordinary—as if I'd give up 
over something like that!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because I swore that I would become her 
rival!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You're far too dazzling, Chiyo-chan. 
Why do you reach your hand out to me like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Capture me with those hands, with those 
eyes. Direct all of that burning spirit at 
me, and me alone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Honing your fangs and glaring for the sake 
of a single prey. Those hungry, wolf-like 
eyes of yours are...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You drive me wild.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I couldn't win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list:
Which GⅠ shall we prove your running in 
next?

Which GⅠ will you prove your running in 
next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Before deciding that, may I make one more 
declaration?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, Sakura Chiyono O 
called Maruzensky up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Maruzen-san. Did you see my run in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, abso-lutely! After all, it is your 
race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Then I imagine you already know 
what it is I wish to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure I still have a long way to go 
before you acknowledge me as your rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, if you tell me straight to my 
face that I'm falling short, I will train 
even harder.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you require time to consider this, I 
shall wait for you as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Until my running reaches your heart.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Building on that, I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I could race with Maruzen-san, there's 
a specific race I had in mind."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo. Turf 2400m, the classic distance. 
The only GⅠ with the exact same conditions 
as the dream you gave me: the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The autumn festival gathering the world's 
elite to determine the strongest—the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, I am well aware that I am not yet 
qualified to stand alongside you. That is 
precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In one year. At next year's Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Will you compete against me with 
everything you've got?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A breeze swept between the two. To call 
that moment brief felt completely wrong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the setting sun continued its 
slow descent, until at last, its light—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...It's so dazzling, it won't even let me 
close my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The sun is already beginning to set. 
There's no going back to my prime.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a flash, Maruzensky tore open the 
envelope in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Please, wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the promise between the two was 
renewed once again in a new form.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you for coming along with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're probably the only one who 
would praise me for that first, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for deciding such a major 
goal on my own."
choice_data_list:
I don't mind—it's your path to walk, after 
all.

I don't mind—it's your path to walk, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list:
However, as your Trainer, I will always 
support you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ahaha. Oh, Trainer, really...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm so glad it was you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, shall we start preparing 
together for one year from now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To light a fire in Maruzen-san's heart, 
which GⅠ should I run in next to grow 
stronger? ...Will you guide me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling her expectant gaze, I ponder. If I 
were to map out her path, there are likely 
two options.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mile route's Yasuda Kinen, to build up 
enough speed to rival the "Supercar," 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Competing against even stronger rivals to 
sharpen her racing instincts— will it be 
the medium-distance route, the Takarazuka 
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one to choose is—
choice_data_list: The Yasuda Kinen on the mile route

The middle-distance race, the Takarazuka 
Kinen

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll jot that down in my 
Chiyo-note right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the decision was made to advance 
to the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Target race changed to the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll jot that down in my 
Chiyo-note right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the decision was made to advance 
to the Takarazuka Kinen.
